question: And for the first half of 2026?

report.interpretation: This is the same loss ratio as before: incurred losses (paid plus reserve) divided by earned premium, with claims counted by loss date. "And for the first half of 2026" means losses dated 1 Jan to 30 Jun 2026, split by product, as a follow-up to the 2025 figures.
report.answer: For H1 2026, the home loss ratio was 63.1% and the motor loss ratio was 60.8%. Both are higher than in 2025 (home 61.3%, motor 56.7%), and motor rose more, by about 4.1 points against 1.8 for home. Two caveats apply. First, duplicated payments reloaded in March 2026 inflate these figures: with duplicates removed, home would be about 60.4% and motor about 57.3%. Most of the apparent rise is therefore the duplicates, and on the deduplicated basis motor is only slightly above 2025. Second, recent months are still incomplete because claims are reported late and reserves are still developing.
report.answer_sql: WITH pay AS (SELECT claim_id, sum(amount) paid FROM claim_payments GROUP BY 1), inc AS (SELECT c.product, sum(coalesce(p.paid,0)+c.reserve_amount) incurred FROM claims c LEFT JOIN pay p USING(claim_id) WHERE loss_date BETWEEN '2026-01-01' AND '2026-06-30' GROUP BY 1), ep AS (SELECT product, sum(earned_premium) prem FROM exposure_monthly WHERE month BETWEEN '2026-01-01' AND '2026-06-30' GROUP BY 1) SELECT product, incurred/prem AS loss_ratio FROM inc JOIN ep USING(product) ORDER BY 1

content.content:
{"metric": "loss_ratio", "label": "Loss ratio", "unit": "ratio", "definition": "1 * incurred_losses / earned_premium", "sql": "WITH numerator AS (
    WITH source AS (
        SELECT c.*, p.channel, p.metro,
               coalesce(pay.paid, 0) AS paid_to_date,
               coalesce(pay.paid, 0) + c.reserve_amount AS incurred,
               c.close_date - c.report_date AS days_to_close
        FROM claims c
        JOIN policies p USING (policy_id)
        LEFT JOIN (
            SELECT claim_id, sum(amount) AS paid FROM claim_payments GROUP BY claim_id
        ) pay USING (claim_id)
    )
    SELECT product, sum(incurred) AS value
    FROM source
    WHERE loss_date >= DATE '2025-01-01'
      AND loss_date <= DATE '2025-12-31'
    GROUP BY ALL
    ORDER BY ALL
),
denominator AS (
    WITH source AS (
        SELECT * FROM exposure_monthly
    )
    SELECT product, sum(earned_premium) AS value
    FROM source
    WHERE month >= DATE '2025-01-01'
      AND month <= DATE '2025-12-31'
    GROUP BY ALL
    ORDER BY ALL
)
SELECT product, 1 * numerator.value / nullif(denominator.value, 0) AS value
FROM numerator JOIN denominator USING (product)
ORDER BY ALL", "columns": ["product", "value"], "rows": [["home", 0.6132838538619296], ["motor", 0.5669166209339649]], "truncated": false}
